purpose: D516 executable semantic-contract gate. This is a reviewed projection boundary for a future Nautilo routine and Room summary; it neither changes nor widens the pinned Cua provider schema.

providerObservationBytes.interpretation: Observed repeated raw provider observation was 8–12KB; this is evidence, not a newly invented provider or routine byte ceiling.

inputTokens.interpretation: Repeated retained observations grew input tokens from 24,020 to 102,052.

projectionInvariant.launchCommonPath: A new routine projection may carry at most one semantic app target and the immediately selected unique semantic window target. It may not carry an application inventory, multiple candidate windows, or native identifiers.
projectionInvariant.deduplication: Unchanged inventory and provider diagnostics never repeat in the model projection or ordinary Room summary.
projectionInvariant.serialization: The test measures exact representative fixture serialization. Repeated identical calls grow only by one compact projection record plus its record separator; retained raw provider payloads are forbidden.
projectionInvariant.noHardCeiling: No hard byte ceiling is asserted because the available baseline is an observation, not a provider contract.

projectionBoundary.rule: Model and ordinary Room projections are public semantic descriptions, never a serialized provider response, error, screenshot, AX tree, native process/window identity, inventory, or diagnostics.
